reviews.text: If you are looking for a clinic for your pet, look no further! CV da Foz is the place to go, with its experienced, professional and humane staff. I have been coming here for 8 years and my only regret is not having started coming sooner. I would like to give a special thank you to Dr. Filipa and Dr. João for their professionalism, dedication and friendship.

I went to this clinic after reading reviews and I didn't regret it. We were met by a wonderful woman at the reception. The waiting room is very clean and comfortable.

We were examined by Dr. Joao, and I want to say that this man really loves animals and cares about their health. He carefully examined everything and explained in detail everything that could be the reason for our visit. The prescribed medications helped! Many thanks!
Best clinic of Porto, the team is very kind and professional motivated by the love for animals. Thank you again for what you did for my white chihuahua.
I've had the best experience here (the cat was diagnosed correctly, and treatment was great). Very much recommend.
The best clinic in the North. Thank you for everything and for the way you treat our best friends.
All excellent, very attentive to the animals.
I like the approach and attention to detail.
Great team of the clinic. Dra. Filipa is absolutely amazing and caring doctor. Thank you!
Excellent professionalism. Everything they do is done with love; they are very caring and attentive to the pet owners. I recommend them.
The most reliable team to take care of my dogs.

My beloved dog passed away suddenly in an accident. I went there not knowing what to do. I received comforting care, my dog ​​was thoroughly cleaned, and I was able to entrust him to the funeral home with ease. I was saved by the kindness and consideration of all the staff and doctors. Thank you.

Welcoming space.
Excellent professionals.
Located right on the banks of the Douro River, and therefore the clinic's location is very beautiful.
The less positive aspect is that there is some difficulty with parking.
